text:
omar: Heads-up — eu1 dedicated pool started seeing a 5xx + tail-latency spike after the canary. Suspect model-redwood-3.2.1. Need rapid decision: pin to 3.1.9 or rollback image. @ops-lead can you weigh in?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: /generate 5xx rate increased to 12% in eu1 since 12:03 UTC. Canary fraction: 10%. Active model: model-redwood-3.2.1. Suggested actions: pin older model or rollback. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback

jess: Any quick perf diffs or sample error logs?

kai: Pasting short tail log snippet: `2026-03-23T12:04:21Z ERROR inference_executor.py: KV cache miss -> OOM, fallback to CPU; trace id=tx-9f3c`
kai: p95 latency jumped +420ms for canary traffic, p50 +150ms.

samir: I can own the rollback/pin ops. My preference is pin to 3.1.9 and skip canary (minimal surface area). Note: there are slight tokenization diffs between 3.2.x and 3.1.x. Need a quick smoke eval after pin.

ops-lead: Rule of thumb: if 5xx >= 10% for 5m -> rollback/pin. We crossed threshold. I approve expedited pin to v3.1.9 and skipping canary. @releasebot please prep changelog/notes.

jess: +1. I'll run smoke tests immediately after. Adding a 20-query eval set to quickcheck.

releasebot: Auto-update queued: Draft release note: "Pin model in eu1 to v3.1.9 to mitigate elevated 5xx rates after v3.2.1 rollout. Investigation ongoing; follow-up postmortem to be filed." PR: https://go/redwood/prs/4872

omar: Invoking pin command now.

omar: ```
/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "5xx spike post canary"
```

deploy-bot: Received pin command from omar. Validating permissions and preflight... Preflight OK. Beginning pin: ramping model-redwood-3.1.9 to 100% in eu1 (skip canary).

jess: Running smoke tests now.
jess: smoke tests: all checks green :white_check_mark: (synthetic latency and generation sanity).

samir: Monitoring metrics and traces. Watching KV cache and GPU memory surface.

deploy-bot: Pin complete. model-redwood-3.1.9 is now active in eu1. 5xx rolling avg back to 0.8% over 2m; p95 latency near baseline. Notifying on-call.

ops-lead: Good work. Keep monitoring for 30m and escalate if regression. File an incident and postmortem.

omar: Filed INC-3456 for investigation and postmortem. I'll own follow-up action items (telemetry improvements + canary gating).

jess: I'll push a small eval PR to lock the smoke set in CI.

samir: 👍 I'll stay on metrics for the next hour.

releasebot: Release notes updated and changelog entry posted.

omar: Thanks everyone — closing this fast path.
